No general-purpose price-deviation circuit breaker found in Lombard's own oracle contracts for BTC/USD. StakedLBTCOracle has an implicit ratio-change threshold (0.1% per interval) that limits the magnitude of ratio updates — acting as a mild circuit breaker for the LBTC/BTC rate oracle. Chainlink BTC/USD native deviation threshold: 0.5% = 50 bps (configured by Chainlink, not Lombard). StakedLBTCOracle ratio-change limit: 0.1% per interval = 10 bps. No Lombard-specific maxDeviationBps value read from source — both thresholds are either Chainlink-native or emergent from the StakedLBTCOracle update model. Green: thresholds are conservative and well within the acceptable range.

Chainlink BTC/USD heartbeat: 3600s (acceptable for volatile assets).
